outcome: Severe intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) or periventricular leukomalacia (PVL)
cohort: 12,014 very preterm infants (VPIs, <32 weeks of gestation) admitted to 18 perinatal centers in China from May 1st, 2015 to April 30th, 2018
finding: Outborn VPIs had a significantly higher risk of DAMA, overall mortality, and severe IVH/PVL compared to inborn infants.
